acceptanceCriteria: Salvage on a retired worker returns a named reason and the retained note path if one exists, not a generic refusal (test)
ATR non-goal updated; focused tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1834 (PR #1153). `dispatch salvage --attempt A` looks the worker up by its directory, so after retention retires the directory (holder still named) it refuses. Related: V1-1768 item (4), CAL-V0-144 retention pruning handoff notes. Expected: salvage for a retired worker reports a named NOT_AVAILABLE reason and points to any retained handoff note, or retention keeps the minimal salvage inputs.
title: dispatch salvage --attempt refuses once the worker directory has been retired
